It's on me.|The bartender offers the trawler a drink|audio=Bartender-Fine.flac|}} A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] '''bartender''' worked in a [[Boatman's Reach|public house]] on the [[Water|ice]] [[planet]] [[Pagodon]]. In [[9 ABY]], three trawlers began harassing a [[The Fledgling Mythrol|Mythrol]] in the bar, which the bartender watched but did nothing to prevent. A [[Din Djarin|Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] named Din Djarin then entered the bar, drawing the attention of the [[Alpha Trawler|alpha trawler]]. After the trawler claimed that [[Mandalorian|Djarin]] had spilled his drink, the bartender offered a new drink free of charge, but Djarin smashed the drink into one of the trawlers heads and quickly defeated the trio. The bounty hunter then revealed that the he was there to collect a [[bounty]] on the [[Mythrol]], whom surrendered to him. ==Biography== ===Prelude to a brawl=== {{Quote|«You spilled my drink.»''"
"''He says you spilled his drink.|The bartender translates what the trawler said to Din Djarin|audio=Bartender-Spilled.flac|}} [[File:Bartender_Mandalorian_and_Trawler.png|thumb|left|300px|The bartender unsucessfully tried to prevent a fight breaking out between Din Djarin and a group of trawlers.]] A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] worked as a [[bartender]] in the [[Boatman's Reach|public house]] at the settlement [[Ferryman's Reach]] on the [[Water|ice]] [[planet]] [[Pagodon]] shortly after the fall of the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[9 ABY]],{{MandoDate|1}} three trawlers led by a [[human]] began harassing a [[The Fledgling Mythrol|Mythrol]] in the bar while the bartender was working. The bartender and other patrons watched and did nothing as the trio threatened to cut off the [[Mythrol]]'s gills and sell them at nearby [[Spaceport|port]]. Just as the lead [[Alpha Trawler|trawler]] produced a [[knife]] and held it up to the Mythrol's face to begin cutting, a [[Din Djarin|Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] named [[Din Djarin]] entered the bar. Distracted by the new arrival, the lead trawler knocked his drink over, which he blamed [[Mandalorian|Djarin]] for. Djarin in turn ignored him, making his way to the bartender. The trawler then abandoned the Mythrol and approached Djarin, again blaming the bounty hunter for spilling his drink. As the trawler was not speaking [[Galactic Basic Standard]], the bartender translated for Djarin and then offered to replace the trawler's drink for free. ===The brawl commences=== [[File:Bartender_horrified.png|thumb|right|250px|The bartender could only watch as Din Djarin killed one of his patrons.]] As the bartender poured the drink, the two other trawlers also approached the bar to surround Din Djarin. The bartender then tried to slide the drink down the bar to the lead trawler, but Djarin caught it mid slide and threw the contents into the face of a [[Quarren]] [[Quarren Trawler|trawler]] before smashing the mug over the head of a second human [[Beta Trawler|trawler]]. As the bartender watched in horror, the bounty hunter smashed the Quarren's head into the bar and drove the lead trawler's knife into his own back. When the Quarren attempted to flee the bounty hunter then [[Death|killed]] it by slicing the trawler in half by closing the bar's telescoping door on it. Din Djarin then approached the Mythrol and revealed he was in the bar to collect a [[bounty]] on him. The Mythrol then surrendered and left the bar with Din Djarin. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Here.|The bartender gives the trawler a free drink to try and prevent a fight|}} The bartender made no attempt to stop the trawlers from terrorizing the Mythrol in his bar, but once Din Djarin entered he tried to stop a fight from breaking out between the bounty hunter and the trawlers. The bartender had [[Color|white]] [[hair]], tanned skin, and brown [[eye]]s. ==Equipment== The bartender wore a brown [[Clothing|shirt]] under a brown overcoat. ==Behind the scenes== The bartender appeared in [[Chapter 1: The Mandalorian|Chapter 1]] of the [[2019]] [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which aired on [[November 12]], 2019.{{WebCite|url=https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf|text=The Mandalorian Media Kit|work=[https://dtcimedia.disney.com Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International]|archivedate=20230315011507}} He is portrayed by [[John Beasley]]. ==Appearances== *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 1: The Mandalorian}} {{1st}} *''[[The Mandalorian: Season 1: Volume 1]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian: The Manga]]'' *[[The Mandalorian 1|''The Mandalorian'' 1]] ==Sources== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of unidentified bartender}} *{{SWYouTube|aOC8E8z_ifw|The Mandalorian | Official Trailer | Disney+ | Streaming Nov. 12|sw_url=video/the-mandalorian-official-trailer}} {{1stp}} *{{SWYouTube|XmI7WKrAtqs|The Mandalorian – Official Trailer 2 | Disney+ | Streaming Nov. 12|sw_url=video/trailer-2-the-mandalorian}} *{{SWYouTube|2RVnrBLOBcI|The Mandalorian | Special Look | Disney+}} *{{DisneyGallery|Score}} *{{DisneyGallery|Connections}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Barman no identificado (Pagodon) |fr=Barman non-identifié (Pagodon) |ja=名称不明のバーテンダー（マンダロリアン） |ka=უცნობი ბარმენი (პაგოდონი) |pl=Barman (Maldo Kreis) }} [[Category:Bartenders]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Males]]
